sources.summary: Artificial Analysis has released version 4.2 of its Intelligence Index, likely in response to criticism that its benchmarks failed to capture GPT-6 Astra's actual progress. The article Artificial Analysis overhauls its Intelligence Index after GPT-6 Astra scoring drew skepticism appeared first on The Decoder .

sources.summary: 徵信調查是風險控管的核心，玉山銀行企業放款餘額超過1兆元，每年玉山法金部門都會重新審視往來企業的信用和財務狀況。不過，傳統法金徵信作業最大痛點是，資料散亂和人工作業耗時。數百名負責徵信作業的客戶關係經理（RM），一年得要撰寫四、五千份徵信報告，每月高達4成的工時都花在蒐集資料上。 玉山銀行花了一年，自行開發了「iCatcher」與智能徵信報告工具「智捷通」等多款AI工具，將授信作業流程中動輒耗費十多小時的資料蒐集及報告初稿製作工作，縮短至分鐘級，推估一年可以節省8.4萬個人時。

sources.summary: Introducing GPT-6 Astra for developers Blink and you'll miss it, but there's a familiar creature at 1m59s : Across the board, Astra has more attention to detail, better understanding of the user's prompt, and can build more sophisticated outputs. In particular, it excels at building 3D models. I've seen it make incredible renderings of gardens, shipyards, animals , cityscapes, even Dyson spheres. Astra really does believe in putting a red neckerchief on a pelican riding a bicycle. Via Hacker News comment Tags: ai , openai , generative-ai , llms , pelican-riding-a-bicycle , gpt-6-astra
sources.summary_zh: 隆重推出開發者的 GPT-6 Astra。一眨眼你可能就錯過了，但在 1 分 59 秒處你會看到一個熟悉的身影：Astra 各方面都更加註重細節，對用戶指令的理解也更透徹，並且能夠產生更複雜的輸出。尤其值得一提的是，它擅長建造 3D 模型。我親眼見證了它如何渲染出令人驚嘆的花園、造船廠、動物、城市景觀，甚至是戴森球。 Astra 真的相信應該給騎自行車的鵜鶘戴上一條紅色領巾。來自 Hacker News 評論 標籤：ai、openai、generative-ai、llms、pelican-riding-a-bicycle、gpt-6-astra

sources.title_en: Nous Research Adds One-Click Local Model Setup to Hermes Desktop
sources.title_original: Nous Research Adds One-Click Local Model Setup to Hermes Desktop
sources.summary: Nous Research has collapsed local model setup into a single click in Hermes Desktop. The app reads your hardware, fit-checks the catalog against your GPU, picks the highest-quality build that fits, downloads it, and configures llama.cpp — with a hard 4-bit floor and a 64K minimum context window. The post Nous Research Adds One-Click Local Model Setup to Hermes Desktop appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: Nous Research 已將 Hermes Desktop 中的本地模型設定簡化為一鍵操作。該應用程式會讀取您的硬體訊息，將目錄中的版本與您的 GPU 進行匹配檢查，選擇最合適的高品質版本，下載該版本，並配置 llama.cpp 檔案——設定最低 4 位元色深和最小 64K 上下文視窗大小。這篇文章《Nous Research 為 Hermes Desktop 添加一鍵本地模型設定》最初發佈於 MarkTechPost。
